description:
LawQi helps lawyers use AI ethically and effectively. 

Drawing on material written specifically to build AI literacy and competency among legal professionals, LawQi provides tips and support where and when you need it most, appearing as a separate interactive card right in your chat. Sources under every answer, and a box to ask follow-ups directly.

Use LawQi to bring guidance on your professional context and obligations into your AI work. Doing so delivers necessary considerations to mind for you, and ensures ChatGPT keeps that context top of mind as well. 

Ask about prompting technique, verifying AI output and catching hallucinations, disclosure and confidentiality obligations when using AI on client matters, the duty of technological competence, choosing and evaluating AI tools, or the ethics of AI use. Address it directly with @LawQi, or let ChatGPT suggest it when your question is in scope.

Answers arrive as a card in the conversation, drawing on the LawQi AI Skill Building course materials — resources written specifically for legal professionals — with sources under every answer. Open the card for the full LawQi thread, ask follow-ups directly, or hand an answer back to ChatGPT to build on.

LawQi is not a legal AI tool and does not provide legal advice. It does not answer substantive legal questions, perform case-law or statutory research, or draft documents.

What LawQi answers
In scope — the practice of using AI in legal work:

Prompting technique, and what makes a prompt produce usable work
Verifying AI output and catching hallucinations
Disclosure and confidentiality obligations when using AI on client matters
The duty of technological competence
Choosing and evaluating AI tools
The ethics of AI use in a practice

Out of scope, and deliberately so:

Substantive legal questions — what the law is, or how it applies to a situation
Case-law and statutory research
Drafting documents, or reviewing ones you are drafting
Anything that would amount to legal advice

A free LawQi account includes 50 queries each month and access to the LawQi learning portal. Creating one takes a minute and happens in the sign-in window the first time you use LawQi. Documentation: plugin.lawqi.com/docs

defaultPrompt: How should a lawyer approach AI-generated work product?
What's the starting point for a lawyer learning to use ChatGPT?
How can I tell if AI for legal work has improved in the past year?
